summary: Iteration-2 re-test of all iteration_1 fixes. Backend: 26 pytest cases (existing 18 + 8 new for iteration-2 fixes) — 26/26 PASSED in 247s against the PUBLIC preview URL, including the CRITICAL SSE longevity regression (rewritten sse_longevity_test.py now emulates the frontend reconnect-with-after_seq behaviour and reaches run_complete). Frontend: launched a FRESH live run from the UI (https://example.com) and the UI did NOT freeze — all 7 DAG nodes reached done, Final Report rendered live (80% pass, 5 flows, 2 passed, 2 self-healed, 1 defect, risk 22) without re-opening the run. Verified events endpoint, REPORT stage_complete, healer heals>=1, budget flow cap, pause+resume (CTA disappears, EVALUATE resets to done, run completes), CodeViewer clean rendering + copy with no CRA overlay/unhandled rejection, blob-based JSON/HTML export downloads (autoqa-<id>.json / .html), all 6 tabs, runs-history navigation, and no zombie running runs after startup reconciliation.

minor.issue: Under back-to-back runs the Emergent/Gemini key returns litellm.RateLimitError and the pipeline logs 'LLM call degraded ... using deterministic fallback' (observed on the pause/resume run: PLAN/EVALUATE/GENERATE all degraded). Behaviour is graceful and the run still completes, but heavy usage silently downgrades plan quality — consider a short retry/backoff before falling back.

issues: Stage durations frequently render as '0.0s' (REPORT always 0.0s, HEAL/RUN often 0.0-0.6s) — sub-second stages read as if untimed; consider ms formatting.
Header status chip shows 'IDLE' after a run finishes instead of 'COMPLETED'; slightly ambiguous vs. the iteration_1 freeze symptom.

action_items: No blocking issues. Optional: add retry/backoff on Gemini RateLimitError before the deterministic fallback; format sub-second stage durations in the DAG; show COMPLETED/FAILED instead of IDLE in the header after a run ends.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js streamRun now reconnects with ?after_seq and Dashboard.js keeps a 5s /events?after_seq polling backstop plus seqRef dedupe — verified resilient to the ~60s ingress cut; no further change needed.
GET /api/runs/{id}/events and /stream both filter seq>after_seq and project away _id — confirmed no duplicate/lost events on reconnect (test asserts strictly increasing seq).
reconcile_orphans() on startup correctly clears running/queued/paused leftovers (iteration_1's zombie run 9ee4e166 is gone; test_no_zombie_running_runs passes).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (live run to REPORT, all 6 tabs, exports, copy, pause/resume, history nav)

seed_data_creation: ~6 new runs against https://example.com (budget quick/standard, one pause_after_plan, one with TEST_ intent/prd and masked password) created via API + UI.
test_credentials: N/A — AutoQA has no auth. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env works (occasional rate limiting under load).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py /app/backend/tests/sse_longevity_test.py -v` (~4 min; real LLM runs). sse_longevity_test.py is the SSE regression: it now reconnects with ?after_seq exactly like api.js and must reach run_complete over the public URL. All iteration_1 issues (60s SSE freeze, REPORT stage_complete, resume CTA/EVALUATE reset, clipboard, highlight leak, window.open export, healed=0, orphan runs, flow cap) are verified FIXED. Editing files under /app/backend/** triggers uvicorn --reload and kills in-flight runs — edit tests before launching runs.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no unresolved defects this iteration.
